description: GET /v1/members/{address}/invites signed as the same address: production refuses a self-lookup ("Users cannot invite themselves"). Signed fetch with the run's throwaway key 0xe45c088898a7381f5ea1bfd8cdc8144a952c7d6f (no data behind it): the baseline answer is the authenticated shape for an unknown wallet; the recorded auth chain is timestamp-bound, so a replay must re-sign the same path and metadata. Captured GET https://social-api.decentraland.org/v1/members/0xe45c088898a7381f5ea1bfd8cdc8144a952c7d6f/invites -> 400.
